name: IWF Emerald City Championship
epitaph: IWF's top championship, born of an eight-man tournament at the fed's own debut pay-per-view and changing hands once, at the promotion's own supershow, before its own record goes quiet with the title still around its second champion's waist.

name: IWF Mount Rainier Championship
notes: Introduced for the fed's own Season 2 relaunch and awarded in a five-man "King of the Mountain" rumble rather than a conventional tournament.
epitaph: A second championship introduced for IWF's own Season 2 relaunch, awarded in a five-man rumble decided as much by faction interference as by the ring itself.
